parameters.query:
SELECT
  c.id::text AS customer_id,
  c.name AS customer_name,
  c.phone,
  t.slug AS tenant_slug,
  wt.phone_number_id,
  MAX(cv.created_at) AS last_visit
FROM customers c
JOIN tenants t ON t.id = c.tenant_id
JOIN wa_tenant_config wt ON wt.tenant_slug = t.slug
LEFT JOIN customer_visits cv ON cv.customer_id = c.id
WHERE
  t.slug = 'wondernails'
  AND c.phone IS NOT NULL
  AND c.phone != ''
  AND wt.phone_number_id IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY c.id, c.name, c.phone, t.slug, wt.phone_number_id
HAVING
  MAX(cv.created_at) IS NOT NULL
  AND MAX(cv.created_at) < NOW() - INTERVAL '15 days'
  AND MAX(cv.created_at) >= NOW() - INTERVAL '16 days'
  AND NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM whatsapp_messages wm
    WHERE wm.numero = c.phone
      AND wm.metadata->>'reminder_type' = 'reactivacion_15d'
      AND wm.created_at >= NOW() - INTERVAL '30 days'
  )
LIMIT 20
